standard-dialogue-when-trying-to-climb-t.npc: Excuse me, human! Perhaps you shouldn't just go wandering through there without knowing what you're dealing with!

standard-dialogue-initial-dialogue.player: Hello! Are you the leader of this expedition?

standard-dialogue-initial-dialogue.npc: Indeed I am, human! What's on your mind?
Huey-co-at... oh, I don't have time for this! The thing you need to know is that it's dangerous and it's coiled throughout this entire mountain!

standard-dialogue-initial-dialogue.player: Do you know where it came from?

standard-dialogue-initial-dialogue.npc: We're not sure. There are some records of our ancestors having dealings with it, but the details have been lost, assuming they were ever recorded.
Does it really matter how old it is?

standard-dialogue-initial-dialogue.player: I suppose not. I guess I just want to get a better understanding of what this thing is.

standard-dialogue-initial-dialogue.npc: We don't know how old it is. It could be extremely old, or this could be just one in a lineage of them. Still, we haven't heard of any others so maybe it is some sort of ancient creature.

standard-dialogue-initial-dialogue.player: And given that you're here, I assume it poses some sort of threat?

standard-dialogue-initial-dialogue.npc: Now you're getting it! While it doesn't seem to be innately aggressive, our concern is the potential risk of it tunnelling into Cam Torum.
Oh, and given that it does lash out from time to time, I suppose it does pose a threat to your nearby human villages. A lesser priority for us, but maybe something for you to care about.
Anyway, for now, our only option is to keep it in check while we figure out what to do in the long term.
Unfortunately, that means recruiting all the help we can get, even from you humans...

standard-dialogue-initial-dialogue.text: If the player has not completed Perilous Moons:

steps.npc: Well, despite what some of us may think of your kind, we need all the help we can get.

standard-dialogue-initial-dialogue.text: If the player has completed Perilous Moons:

steps.npc: Well, as you've already proven yourself useful to Cam Torum, I'd be glad to have you help here!

standard-dialogue-initial-dialogue.text: If the player has a combat level below 85:

steps.npc: However, I'm not sure you have enough combat experience to face the Hueycoatl.

steps.text: To face the Hueycoatl, it's recommended you have a combat level of 85 and a Prayer level of 43.

standard-dialogue-initial-dialogue.text: If the player has a combat level above 85:

steps.npc: We need to keep the Hueycoatl under control which, until we find a more permanent solution, means wearing it out through combat.
Don't go killing it, mind you! Not that I think you could, but such a magnificent creature doesn't deserve destruction.

steps.player: Do you have any tips for surviving?

steps.npc: We've found our prayers can protect us from its shards, so keep an eye out for those.
To reach the Hueycoatl's head, you'll need to get it to move its great body out of the way. We've found we can persuade it by giving the exposed parts a helpful nudge!
Once you reach its head, you'll need to work with your comrades and the seer to balance your prayers and weaken the beast.
But I'm sure you'll figure it out!

steps.player: Move the body, then attack the head while keeping prayers balanced. Got it!

steps.player: Are there any rewards for helping?

steps.npc: Ugh, you greedy humans.
The Hueycoatl displaces a lot of materials as it moves, including all sorts of items and treasures.
We collect as much as we can, so I suppose you can have a share for helping.
Bye.
